newsitem.title: USA: EVEREN Capital unit sells trust sponsorship.
newsitem.headline: EVEREN Capital unit sells trust sponsorship.

text.p: EVEREN Capital Corp said Wednesday its EVEREN Securities unit transferred sponsorship and other activities relating to more than 600 unit investment trusts to Ranson & Associates Inc. Financial terms were not disclosed.
The move will allow EVEREN to focus on its core brokerage services and investment banking operations by shedding a non-core business, chairman and chief executive James Boris said in a statement.
EVEREN Securities is a full-service brokerage firm.
EVEREN Capital's stock was down 1/8 at 22-1/2.
